newsitem.title: USA: Phelps Dodge Q3 trails expectations.
newsitem.headline: Phelps Dodge Q3 trails expectations.

text.p: Phelps Dodge Corp Thursday reported third quarter net income of $80.2 million, or $1.22 per share, compared to the First Call concensus estimate of $1.31.
Net income was $211.8 million, or $3.03 per share, in the 1995 third quarter.
Sales were $853.6 million in the latest quarter, compared with $1.08 billion a year earlier.
The company said the 1996 decrease primarily was a result of lower average copper prices and lower sales volumes of wheels and rims.
The decrease was offset partially by higher sales volumes of wire and cable products, it added.
Phelps Dodge said its share of mine production from worldwide operations was 187,900 tons of copper in the 1996 third quarter. This compares with 182,300 tons in the 1995.
Copper sales from mine production were 194,500 tons in the 1996 third quarter compared with 196,600 tons a year earlier.

As of October 9, the company said, it had net positions in place that provide for a minimum 1996 fourth quarter average price of $0.95 per pound for 95 million pounds of copper cathode and a minimum 1997 first quarter average price of $0.90 per pound for 85 million pounds of copper cathode.
These minimum prices are based on average London Metal Exchange prices, it noted.
It said contracts ensuring minimum prices for 185 million pounds of 1996 third quarter copper production resulted in payments of $3.1 million to Phelps Dodge.

During the 1996 third quarter, the company noted, it liquidated a portion of its copper price protection contracts that covered anticipated mine production in the fourth quarter of 1996 and the first quarter of 1997. This resulted in cash payments to the company of $15.6 million.

It said the related gains, $8.8 million for the 1996 fourth quarter contracts and $6.8 million for the 1997 first quarter contracts, will be deferred and recognized in income during the periods to which the original contracts were applicable. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
